Public FFmpeg 7.1 headers from the existing devkitPro SDK recovery. Pinned ABI: avcodec 61, avformat 61, avutil 59. Original copyright and LGPL/GPL notices remain in each header. Only public declarations are included, not codec sources or fonts. Desktop dynamically loads those matching major-version libraries; Switch links the same SDK libraries. See https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html and https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-7.1.tar.xz for upstream licensing and complete source.
